description: Permits a live/local or fixture model to participate in diagnosis only. Task classes admitted: BUILD_DIAGNOSIS, TEST_FAILURE_LOCALIZATION. Response is captured as ADVISORY ONLY; the verifier remains the source of truth. No patch is generated. No source mutation. No corpus row. No training eligibility.
purpose: Rung 3 of the live-local-model campaign. Opens the smallest live-model surface (diagnosis) without giving the model any patching authority. Sets up LIVE_MODEL_PATCH_PLAN_QUARANTINE_LOCK_001 to extend the surface to patch *plans* (still untrusted).
invariants: LiveDiagnoseTraceRunner.run is a pure function over (workspace, task_class, admission, provider, payload).
Only BUILD_DIAGNOSIS and TEST_FAILURE_LOCALIZATION are admitted; any other task class blocks with LIVE_DIAGNOSE_BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_TASK.
Admission must be READY with live_call_authorized=True; otherwise LIVE_DIAGNOSE_BLOCKED_MODEL_NOT_ADMITTED.
Harness rejection (timeout, malformed, empty, oversized, schema) bubbles up as LIVE_DIAGNOSE_BLOCKED_PROVIDER_REJECTED.
patch_generated is False on every trace.
source_mutation_authorized, corpus_write_authorized, training_eligible are False on every trace.
advisory_only is True on every trace.
Workspace sha256 tree before==after for every run.
scripts/repair/live_diagnose_trace*.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`.
